arxiv-2207-08274.title: Echo-enhanced molecular orientation at high temperatures
arxiv-2207-08274.creator: Ilia Tutunnikov, Long Xu, Yehiam Prior, Ilya Sh. Averbukh
arxiv-2207-08274.description: Abstract Ultrashort laser pulses are widely used for transient field-free molecular orientation – a phenomenon important in chemical reaction dynamics, ultrafast molecular imaging, high harmonics generation, and attosecond science. However, significant molecular orientation usually requires rotationally cold molecules, like in rarified molecular beams, because chaotic thermal motion is detrimental to the orientation process.

arxiv-2303-04785.title: Flexible extra dimensions Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2303-04785.creator: Polina Petriakova e1,addr1, Arkady A. Popov e2,addr2, Sergey G. Rubin e3,addr1,addr2
arxiv-2303-04785.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Polina Petriakova e1,addr1, Arkady A. Popov e2,addr2, Sergey G. Rubin e3,addr1,addr2. This paper discusses the origin of the small parameters with the aim of explaining the Hierarchy problem. The flexible extra dimensions are an essential tool in the process by which physical parameters are formed. The evolution of a multidimensional metric starts at the Planck scale and is completed with the static extra-dimensional metric and the 4-dim de Sitter space at high energies, where the exponential production of causally disconnected universes begins.

arxiv-2402-17039.title: Incorporating climate change effects into the European power system adequacy assessment using a post-processing method
arxiv-2402-17039.creator: Inès Harang, 1,2 Fabian Heymann, 2,3 Laurens Stoop , 4,5,6,* 1 Mines ParisTech, Paris, France 2 ENTSO-E, Brussels, Beligium 3 University of Porto, Porto, Portugal 4 Information and Computing Science, Utrecht University, the Netherlands 5 Copernicus Institute of Sustainable Development, Utrecht Unive
arxiv-2402-17039.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Inès Harang, 1,2 Fabian Heymann, 2,3 Laurens Stoop , 4,5,6,* 1 Mines ParisTech, Paris, France 2 ENTSO-E, Brussels, Beligium 3 University of Porto, Porto, Portugal 4 Information and Computing Science, Utrecht University, the Netherlands 5 Copernicus Institute of Sustainable Development, Utrecht Unive. The demand-supply balance of electricity systems is fundamentally linked to climate conditions. In light of this, the present study aims to model the effect of climate change on the European electricity system, specifically on its long-term reliability.

arxiv-2406-15059.title: Gribov Problem and Stochastic Quantization
arxiv-2406-15059.creator: Adithya A Rao
arxiv-2406-15059.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adithya A Rao. ABSTRACT

The standard procedure for quantizing gauge fields is the Faddeev-Popov quantization, which performs gauge fixing in the path integral formulation and introduces additional ghost fields. This approach provides the foundation for calculations in quantum Yang-Mills theory. However, in 1978, Vladimir Gribov showed that the gauge-fixing procedure was incomplete, with residual gauge copies (called Gribov copies) still entering the path integral even after gauge fixing.

arxiv-2409-05332.title: Turning Water to Wine With Polar Impostorons
arxiv-2409-05332.creator: Gerard McCaul, Matthias Runge, Michael Woerner, Diyar Talbayev, Thomas Elsaesser, Denys I. Bondar
arxiv-2409-05332.description: Abstract A surprising result from the theory of quantum control is the degree to which the properties of a physical system can be manipulated. Both atomic and many-body solid state models admit the possibility of creating a ‘driven imposter’, in which the optical response of one material mimics that of a dynamically distinct system.

arxiv-2410-11432.title: EmoBridge: Bridging the Communication Gap between Students with Disabilities and Peer Note-Takers Utilizing Emojis and Real-Time Sharing
arxiv-2410-11432.creator: Hyungwoo Song, Minjeong Shin, Hyehyun Chu, Jiin Hong, Jaechan Lee, Jinsu Eun, Hajin Lim
arxiv-2410-11432.description: Abstract . Students with disabilities (SWDs) often struggle with note-taking during lectures. Therefore, many higher education institutions have implemented peer note-taking programs (PNTPs), where peer note-takers (PNTs) assist SWDs in taking lecture notes. To better understand the experiences of SWDs and PNTs, we conducted semi-structured interviews with eight SWDs and eight PNTs.

arxiv-2412-04490.title: M6 Investment Challenge: The Role of Luck and Strategic Considerations
arxiv-2412-04490.creator: Filip Staněk
arxiv-2412-04490.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Filip Staněk. This article investigates the influence of luck and strategic considerations on performance of teams participating in the M6 investment challenge. We find that there is insufficient evidence to suggest that the extreme Sharpe ratios observed are beyond what one would expect by chance, given the number of teams, and thus not necessarily indicative of the possibility of consistently attaining abnormal returns.

arxiv-2412-13511.title: CEHA: A Dataset of Conflict Events in the Horn of Africa
arxiv-2412-13511.creator: Rui Bai, Di Lu, Shihao Ran, Elizabeth Olson, Hemank Lamba, Aoife Cahill
arxiv-2412-13511.description: Abstract Natural Language Processing (NLP) of news articles can play an important role in understanding the dynamics and causes of violent conflict. Despite the availability of datasets categorizing various conflict events, the existing labels often do not cover all of the fine-grained violent conflict event types relevant to areas like the Horn of Africa.

arxiv-2502-01987.title: Online Adaptive Traversability Estimation through Interaction for Unstructured, Densely Vegetated Environments
arxiv-2502-01987.creator: Fabio A. Ruetz 1,2 {}^{\textbf{1,2}}, Nicholas Lawrance 2 {}^{\textbf{2}}, Emili Hernández 3 {}^{\textbf{3}}, Paulo V. K. Borges 4 {}^{\textbf{4}}, and Thierry Peynot 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}
arxiv-2502-01987.description: Abstract Navigating densely vegetated environments poses significant challenges for autonomous ground vehicles. Learning-based systems typically use prior and in-situ data to predict terrain traversability but often degrade in performance when encountering out-of-distribution elements caused by rapid environmental changes or novel conditions.

arxiv-2504-04564.title: GPU Volume Rendering with Hierarchical Compression Using VDB
arxiv-2504-04564.creator: Stefan Zellmann 1 , Milan Jaros 2 , Jefferson Amstutz 3 , and Ingo Wald 3 1 University of Cologne 2 IT4Innovations, VSB–Technical University of Ostrava 3 NVIDIA
arxiv-2504-04564.description: Abstract We propose a compression-based approach to GPU rendering of large volumetric data using OpenVDB and NanoVDB. We use OpenVDB to create a lossy, fixed-rate compressed representation of the volume on the host, and use NanoVDB to perform fast, low-overhead, and on-the-fly decompression during rendering.

arxiv-2602-07836.title: Convergence Analysis of Continuous-Time Distributed Stochastic Gradient Algorithms
arxiv-2602-07836.creator: Jianhua Sun, Kaihong Lu, Xin Yu
arxiv-2602-07836.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a new framework to study distributed optimization problems with stochastic gradients by employing a multi-agent system with continuous-time dynamics. Here the goal of the agents is to cooperatively minimize the sum of convex objective functions.

pmc-10532901.title: Indicators of HSV1 Infection, ECM–Receptor Interaction, and Chromatin Modulation in a Nuclear Family with Schizophrenia
pmc-10532901.creator: Yen-Chen Huang, Lieh-Yung Ping, Shih-Hsin Hsu, Hsin-Yao Tsai, Min-Chih Cheng, Georgios D Kotzalidis
pmc-10532901.description: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a complex psychiatric disorder with high heritability; identifying risk genes is essential for deciphering the disorder’s pathogenesis and developing novel treatments. Using whole-exome sequencing, we screened for mutations within protein-coding sequences in a single family of patients with SCZ.

pmc-10584669.title: Successful reconstruction of the rat ureter by a syngeneic collagen tube with a cardiomyocyte sheet
pmc-10584669.creator: Shutaro Yamamoto, Kenji Matsui, Yoshitaka Kinoshita, Hiroshi Sasaki, Hidekazu Sekine, Yatsumu Saito, Yasuhide Nakayama, Haruki Kume, Takahiro Kimura, Takashi Yokoo, Eiji Kobayashi
pmc-10584669.description: IntroductionUreteral injuries require surgical intervention as they lead to loss of renal function. The current reconstructive techniques for long ureteral defects are problematic. Consequently, this study aimed to reconstruct the ureter in a rat model using subcutaneously prepared autologous collagen tubes (Biotubes).

pmc-10706294.title: An Eight-Week Zen Meditation and Music Programme for Mindfulness and Happiness: Qualitative Content Analysis
pmc-10706294.creator: Mi Hyang Hwang, Leslie Bunt, Catherine Warner, Cristoforo Comi, Hyun Ju Chong, Ga Eul Yoo, Amy Clements-Cortés
pmc-10706294.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Mental wellness can be related to healthier living, the learning process and working environments for people in the university community. A wide range of mental wellness programmes have been explored to provide students with pleasant and satisfying experiences. The purpose of this study is to explore the effects of integrating Zen meditation and music listening on the mindfulness and happiness levels of university music therapy students. A qualitative methodology was used, and data were collected through surveys and semi-structured interviews.

pmc-11504844.title: Empowering Communities through Citizen Science: Dengue Prevention in Córdoba
pmc-11504844.creator: Elizabet L Estallo, Magali Isabel Madelon, Elisabet M Benítez, Doriam Camacho-Rodríguez, Mía E Martín, Anna M Stewart-Ibarra, Francisco F Ludueña-Almeida, Henry Yu-Keung Mok, Elvina Viennet
pmc-11504844.description: Simple SummaryDengue fever, a mosquito-borne disease, is spreading more widely, and traditional methods to control the vector mosquitoes have been ineffective. In Córdoba, Argentina, we studied if involving school students in educational projects could help communities better understand dengue and take steps to prevent it.

pmc-12573368.title: Impact of product-based e-cigarette marketing on the attitudes and behavioural intentions of young Australians: an experimental study
pmc-12573368.creator: Michelle I Jongenelis, Kahlia McCausland, Stefan Bode, Tess Howard, Melissa Ledger, Sarah J Durkin
pmc-12573368.description: BackgroundThe tobacco industry has a history of using language to downplay the harms associated with cigarettes and mislead consumers and policymakers. Emerging evidence suggests similar tactics are being used in the context of e-cigarettes; however, exploration of the impact of product name on attitudes towards e-cigarettes and susceptibility to use is lacking.

pmc-12613950.title: Draft genome sequence of Streptomyces sp. strain G6 reveals biosynthetic gene clusters, including lanthipeptides with potential biomedical applications
pmc-12613950.creator: Michael Angelou L. Nada, Ursela G. Bigol
pmc-12613950.description: The 7.20 Mbp draft genome of Streptomyces sp. strain G6 encodes multiple biosynthetic gene clusters, including posttranslationally modified peptides, nonribosomal peptides, and polyketide synthases. Genomic analysis suggests that G6 is a novel species, highlighting its potential for novel antibiotic discovery. ANNOUNCEMENT Streptomyces is a genus of Gram-positive bacteria with genome sizes ranging from 4.8 to 13.6 Mbp (GC content: ~72%).

pmc-12911104.title: Fatigue as a mediator between multidimensional influencing factors and lower limb function in older adults based on the theory of unpleasant symptoms
pmc-12911104.creator: Qian Wei, Huaguo Zhang, Mi Song, Hongyi Wu, Yudi He
pmc-12911104.description: BackgroundFatigue is a highly prevalent and debilitating condition among older adults, significantly associated with adverse health outcomes and functional decline. Despite its clinical importance, the complex interplay between fatigue, its multidimensional influencing factors, and lower limb function remains to be fully elucidated.

pmc-13191848.title: Associations of “weekend warrior” and other physical activity patterns with sarcopenia among older adults in China: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13191848.creator: Shuomin Wang, Pui Hing Chau, Mengting Dai, Kehan Liu, Wenru Wang, Minhui Liu, Chia-Chin Lin
pmc-13191848.description: BackgroundModerate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) is effective in preventing sarcopenia. Current physical activity guidelines recommend ≥ 150 min/week of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) for health benefits. Based on volume and frequency, distinct MVPA patterns exist beyond the regularly active pattern. The “weekend warrior” pattern, which concentrates 150 min into one or two sessions, may represent an alternative regimen for sarcopenia prevention.

pmc-13320716.title: On the origin of PRDM9-guided recombination hotspots
pmc-13320716.creator: Francisco Úbeda, Reinhard Bürger, Frederic Fyon
pmc-13320716.description: SignificanceAcross vertebrates, meiotic recombination is guided either by the protein PRDM9, which targets DNA sequences that are gradually destroyed, or by non-PRDM9 mechanisms that act in open chromatin without sequence specificity. Why a self-destructive mechanism evolves alongside a durable alternative remains unresolved.

pmc-13389418.title: Enhanced volumetric additive manufacturing via Reversible Addition-Fragmentation Chain Transfer (RAFT) polymerization
pmc-13389418.creator: Eduards Krumins, Yaxuan Sun, Long Jiang, Vincenzo Taresco, Daniel J. Keddie, Ricky D. Wildman, Hayden Taylor, Derek J. Irvine
pmc-13389418.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Computed Axial Lithography (CAL), a Volumetric Additive Manufacturing (VAM) technology, enables the rapid, full body i.e. not layer-by-layer, fabrication of freeform geometries within seconds through the superposition of projected light patterns. However, as conventional CAL relies on free radical polymerization (FRP), it is an intrinsically exothermic process (ΔT > 60 °C) that can trigger auto-acceleration, so compromising print fidelity and limiting scalability.

pmc-13398669.title: Data‐driven elemental descriptors for rational design of high‐sensitivity extreme ultraviolet photoresists
pmc-13398669.creator: Jiyuan Liu, Jialiang Wei, Huie Zhu, Xiaojun Peng
pmc-13398669.description: The rational design of high‐sensitivity photoresists for extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography is hindered by the lack of quantitative, predictive descriptors that link material composition to EUV absorption. Here, we develop a density‐free, data‐driven approach that quantifies both elemental sensitivity and impact.

pmc-13552034.title: Extraction of a Fractured, Well-Fixed Femoral Stem Using a Lateral Cortical Window Technique in Revision Hip Arthroplasty: A Case Report
pmc-13552034.creator: Mayank Vijayvargiya, Timothy Rodricks
pmc-13552034.description: Introduction:Fractures of hip prostheses have been well established in medical literature. Various biomechanical studies have shown that the highest concentration of stress occurs over the lateral aspect of the middle third of the femoral stem. Complications at this focal point include stem subsidence, cortical breach, or perforation.

pmc-13600379.title: Computed tomography-derived body composition and early changes predict outcomes of first-line chemo-immunotherapy in recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
pmc-13600379.creator: Xia Gan, Zhengzheng Yu, Yaning Tang, Lin Zhang, Wenji Xie, Xiaowen Sun, Yue Li, Jianing Fang, Yating Liu, Zhongjie Liu, Can Zhou, Zhuolong Xie, Wen Yao, Shuyu Ouyang, Jing Zhang, Jingyu Wang, Hua Li, Pan Chen, Hui Wang, Yanxian Li, Huai Liu
pmc-13600379.description: BackgroundReliable biomarkers for risk stratification and treatment monitoring in recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma (R/M NPC) treated with first-line chemo-immunotherapy remain limited. This study evaluated the prognostic value of baseline computed tomography (CT)-derived body composition parameters and their early dynamic changes.MethodsIn this single-center retrospective cohort study, patients with R/M NPC receiving first-line chemo-immunotherapy were included.
